story_founding_roots.title: From Pashtoon Roots to a Living Multigenerational Legacy
story_founding_roots.excerpt: How Grandfather Muhammad Ghulam and Grandmother Amna Gulam built a home anchored in Pashtoon honor, education, and kinship.
story_founding_roots.content:
Every enduring family begins with two individuals whose quiet perseverance shapes generations yet unborn. Grandfather Muhammad Ghulam and Grandmother Amna Gulam established a household where elders were honored, children were encouraged to learn, and relatives from every branch always found an open hujra and warm hospitality.

This digital chronicle preserves those memories so grandchildren and great-grandchildren across the world can trace their roots, celebrate milestones, and carry forward a shared heritage.
